context: M8 o6. Rita's bar. Delphine slides onto a stool, breathing hard. Brannock bursts in a beat later.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Sugar, you've been on that stool an hour. Haven't you?

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Hour and a half. Gin and tonic, no gin.

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: Rita. A woman came in here. Tall. Red dress. Bag.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Officer, every woman in here is tall in the right light. You drinking or leaving?

lines.speaker: char.jimmy_brannock
lines.text: I'll find the camera, Delphine. I'll find the film.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Film? Honey, I don't even own a radio.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Twenty years on that avenue. Knees like a trucker, memory like a cop. Show me later.
